policy: P0 Clawix macOS UX work must be measurable from agent-control-bus actions to visual completion, geometry, scroll stability, hitches, resources, and approved baseline comparison. Computer Use may witness but must not be the primary measurement dependency.

activationPolicy.harnessMode: explicit agent instance launch argument or environment only

overheadContract.normalAppHighCardinalityInstrumentation: disabled unless CLAWIX_AGENT_INSTANCE=1 or an explicit diagnostic flag enables a diagnostic probe
overheadContract.normalAppControlRegistration: accessibilityIdentifier only; no frame probes, registry writes, control server, fixture mutation, screenshots, or event JSONL writer
overheadContract.harnessEvidenceWrites: per-run evidence directory outside the main app database; default root is an operating-system temporary directory
overheadContract.harnessDisabledControlRun: runtime overhead comparison is explicit: pass a public-safe harness-disabled control artifact with --overhead-control <file>, otherwise evidence must record external_pending_control_run
staticVerification: ClxControlModifier registers probes only under ClxAgentInstance.isAgent
ClxAgentInstance starts the loopback control server only when CLAWIX_AGENT_INSTANCE=1
run_macos_ux_trace_harness writes evidence only to the selected per-run directory
run_macos_ux_trace_harness records mainDatabaseTraceWrites=false in run and suite artifacts
run_macos_ux_trace_harness records overheadCalibration in run and suite artifacts

privateBoundary.realEquivalentCalibration: aggregate metrics only; synthetic profiles must match or exceed private real-mode P95 for P0 flows when calibration evidence is available

traceSurfaces.visibilityContract: main shell visible and not blocked by modal overlay
traceSurfaces.criticalityReason: Launch is the first product perception point; every later UX trace depends on a usable main window.
The sidebar is the primary monitoring and navigation surface for many parallel conversations.
All Chats is the baseline navigation path back to the complete conversation set.
Pinned navigation must stay responsive because users rely on it to monitor important active work.
Project navigation exercises grouped conversation density and must not degrade sidebar responsiveness.
Dense conversation lists are the main scaling risk for monitoring many active agents.
Conversation rows are the action targets for opening heavy chats and preserving selected-state clarity.
Hover feedback exposes perceived latency and row invalidation pressure in dense sidebars.

traceSurfaces.geometryContract: selected row Y remains stable after selection
traceSurfaces.criticalityReason: Selection visibility and position prove navigation completed without losing user orientation.

traceSurfaces.visibilityContract: running/unread/progress indicator visible when fixture declares it
traceSurfaces.criticalityReason: Running and unread indicators are how users track active agent work across many conversations.

traceSurfaces.visibilityContract: chat route selected and container visible
traceSurfaces.criticalityReason: The chat route container proves navigation reached the conversation surface before transcript readiness is measured.

traceSurfaces.geometryContract: scroll state, viewport, document size, and bottom distance available
traceSurfaces.criticalityReason: Transcript scroll geometry protects the latest-message window, history loading, and bottom anchoring.
Seeing the latest meaningful messages is the north-star completion condition for opening heavy chats.

traceSurfaces.visibilityContract: visible message row has stable identity or row proxy
traceSurfaces.criticalityReason: Stable message row geometry is required to prove scroll anchoring and coherent transcript painting.
The visible user message proves send completion from the user perspective.
Assistant message visibility is the core monitoring output for active agent conversations.

traceSurfaces.visibilityContract: tool/action/work summary visible when fixture declares it
traceSurfaces.criticalityReason: Tool and work summaries show what agents are doing and must remain stable inside dense transcripts.

traceSurfaces.visibilityContract: assistant placeholder visible after send/mock stream
traceSurfaces.criticalityReason: The streaming placeholder proves the app responded immediately after a send or mock stream starts.
Streaming deltas are the fastest feedback that an agent is actively producing output.
Composer input responsiveness is required for user control while conversations are heavy or streaming.

traceSurfaces.visibilityContract: send button visible and enabled when input is sendable
traceSurfaces.criticalityReason: The send button is the primary action that starts new visible conversation output.

traceSurfaces.visibilityContract: stop/cancel generation control visible when generation is active
traceSurfaces.criticalityReason: Stop control availability protects user control over active generations under load.
Opening the terminal under conversation load must not block the main monitoring workflow.
Terminal panel geometry proves auxiliary output can be opened, viewed, and scrolled under load.
Blocking loading states must be visible to distinguish waiting from broken or frozen UI.
Blocking errors must be observable as failed visual completion rather than mistaken as success.
Blocking overlays can invalidate all main-flow latency measurements if they are not explicitly detected.
Settings is an auxiliary route whose opening latency must be tracked without compromising P0 chat flow.

traceSurfaces.visibilityContract: settings/account popover trigger visible in the sidebar
traceSurfaces.criticalityReason: The account popover trigger starts the Settings route flow and must be addressable without cursor witnesses.

traceSurfaces.visibilityContract: account identity row visible inside the settings popover
traceSurfaces.criticalityReason: The account row is a passive readiness anchor proving the popover became visible.

traceSurfaces.visibilityContract: settings navigation row visible inside the settings popover
traceSurfaces.criticalityReason: The Settings row is the action target whose visual completion is the Settings route becoming visible.

traceSurfaces.visibilityContract: sign-out row visible inside the settings popover
traceSurfaces.criticalityReason: The destructive account action must remain directly identifiable for safety and traceability.
Right sidebar opening is an auxiliary workflow that must not degrade the main monitoring path.
Search/palette readiness affects finding conversations in dense workloads.
Diagnostics are tracked as optional support tooling without blocking P0 UX closure.

sent user messages are completion targets for composer KPIs
assistant output visibility is the core monitoring surface

streaming deltas must be measured from receive to visible text
typing latency and send readiness depend on input geometry
send action must be measured through visible user-message completion
active generation cancellation is a core visible control under load
terminal open latency under load is a P0 workflow

destructive account action must remain directly traceable

fixtureProfiles.scaleIntent: many conversations, projects, pinned rows, running states, and row metadata churn
heavy transcript with latest-message visibility, history paging, markdown, and tool summaries
many streaming deltas, placeholder transitions, finalization, and unrelated invalidation pressure
terminal open/switch/scroll while chat and sidebar workloads are active
opt-in stress profile intended to find nonlinear bottlenecks
private aggregate calibration profile with no exported private content
